He wore a bronze coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels, and he had armor of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders. The shaft of his spear was like a weaverʼs beam, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. In addition, his shield bearer went before him.
